Paused pending a decision or dependency — usually a client-side call (Margo/Julia) or an external approval (e.g., a Figma mockup sign-off).
Confirmed shipped, with the changelog week or Slack message cited as evidence in Solution.
Breaks trust in the data or blocks the Sept 8 timeline; needs attention before Julia leaves Aug 22.
Real data-accuracy or workflow bug affecting daily operations; should be next in line.
Real gap or feature request, not urgent this week.
Cosmetic/label change, already answered, or already Done — no pressing action needed.
Where the item came from: today's Slack channel, a Read AI meeting (with meeting ID), the existing Airtable feedback table, or the repo/README/changelog audit.
